rules.name: Time-pressure threat or deadline
rules.description: Pressuring the recipient with short time limits or impending suspension/arrest.
rules.explanation: Urgency can pressure people to act before verifying.

rules.name: Legal action or arrest threat
rules.description: Threatening police involvement, arrest warrants, legal prosecution, or fines.
rules.explanation: Threats of immediate arrest or legal action are commonly used to coerce compliance.

rules.name: OTP / Credential request
rules.description: Requesting OTPs, passwords, PINs, or card security codes.
rules.explanation: Authentication codes and PINs should never be shared with anyone.

rules.name: Upfront fee or suspicious payment method
rules.description: Demanding registration fees, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or wire transfers.
rules.explanation: Legitimate employers, institutions, or delivery services do not demand upfront fees or payment in gift cards/crypto.

rules.name: Demand for immediate payment
rules.description: Direct requests to transfer or pay money.
rules.explanation: Verify payment requests independently before transferring any money.

rules.name: Unrealistic reward or unsolicited win
rules.description: Claims of lottery wins, guaranteed income, or jobs requiring no interview/experience.
rules.explanation: Unexpected rewards or jobs promising high pay with no interview are common lure tactics.

rules.name: Institutional impersonation cue
rules.description: Claiming to represent a bank, official department, customs, HR, or law enforcement.
rules.explanation: The claim alone does not verify the sender's identity. Impersonation of institutions is frequent in scam messages.

rules.name: Channel shift to private messaging or secrecy
rules.description: Directing communication to Telegram or WhatsApp, or demanding secrecy from family/banks.
rules.explanation: Moving to private encrypted chat apps or requesting secrecy makes checking harder and shields scammers.
